{"command": "python3 -c '
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0031.png"))
# Stool top
mask_top = (img[:, :, 0] > 100) & (img[:, :, 0] < 160) & (img[:, :, 1] > 50) & (img[:, :, 1] < 90) & (img[:, :, 2] < 50)
ys, xs = np.where(mask_top)
print(f"Stool top in 31: xs=[{xs.min()}, {xs.max()}], ys=[{ys.min()}, {ys.max()}], cx={xs.mean():.1f}")

# Find lowest leg pixel
mask_legs = (img[:, :, 0] > 50) & (img[:, :, 0] < 95) & (img[:, :, 1] > 55) & (img[:, :, 1] < 100) & (img[:, :, 2] > 65) & (img[:, :, 2] < 110)
cond = mask_legs & (np.arange(512)[None, :] >= xs.min() - 10) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] <= xs.max() + 10) & (np.arange(512)[:, None] > ys.max())
ys_l, xs_l = np.where(cond)
print(f"Stool legs in 31: bottom={ys_l.max()}")
'", "description": "Find stool ground contact in obs_0031"}
